title: Clarify the shared data layer's scope and data responsibilities
requirements:
- Recognise that interoperability can be achieved through data-level integration as well as exchange topology
- Subdivide the foundational shared data layer conceptually so its distinct data responsibilities are visible
- Say the components form part of the technical foundation for progress toward REDDHI
- Extend the modularity test to cover data coupling (data models, shared databases, documented dependencies)
